title: RSI divergence (1h and 4h) with a fixed 1R/2R bracket and taker fees, split by BTC market phase

what.name: Signal
what.value_plain: The 643 RSI-divergence events of the layer lab table (interval 3 to 10 bars, bullish = long, bearish = short); 3 dropped for no full 24-bar window, 640 kept
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Timeframe / market
what.value_plain: BTCUSDT perpetual, 1h (502 events) and 4h (138 events) bars
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Entry
what.value_plain: Open of the bar after the signal bar
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Stop / target
what.value_plain: Stop 1.0 R, target 2.0 R, with R = ATR(14) at entry; both multiples fixed before any outcome was read, not tuned
what.label: OURS

what.name: Same-bar touch of stop and target
what.label: OURS

what.name: Fees
what.value_plain: Taker on every leg, 0.05 % per side (Binance USDT-M); no slippage, no funding
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Phase tags
what.value_plain: Cowen band side, 200-day average side and weekly 10-average phase of the day, from bars closed the day before
what.label: OURS

what.name: Cell rule
what.value_plain: n >= 200 decides, 30 to 199 reported only, under 30 too small; block-bootstrap 95 % CI
what.label: OURS

how: Every event is replayed bar by bar with the bracket above (frozen in PRE_REG.md before any outcome). Net R = gross R minus the two taker legs. Then the same events are grouped by the phase tag of their day and each cell is scored with a block-bootstrap CI.
window: DEV 2022-01 to 2024-06 (bars opening before 2024-07-01; later data never read)

verdict.label: Negative: every phase cell loses after fees, no PASS

why: Pooled net -0.229 R per trade on 640 events (gross -0.100 R): fees alone cost about 0.13 R per trade.
No cell has a positive CI. The shift test finds no phase tag that separates the cells beyond chance.
4h is the only positive slice (net +0.042 R) but n = 138 is under the decide bar of 200.
Other brackets are untested and would be a new pre-registration. Edge claimed: none.
